daily.title: 오늘 6000보 걷기
daily.goal_source: User request: daily walking quest with a 6000-step goal
daily.evidence_window: All verified incremental walking records on the quest date, including records before acceptance

provisional.daily_reward_exp: 10 EXP is a development balance placeholder, not a finalized game reward
provisional.mini_reward_exp: walk_500=5 and walk_1000=8 preserve existing rule rewards; other entries use the existing Character Lab default of 5 EXP
provisional.expiry: When the virtual date becomes later than due_date, unaccepted created quests become expired; accepted/in_progress quests become failed. No reward is paid. The caller may apply the existing quest-failure Mood rule once for accepted quests.
provisional.daily_generation: Create one daily quest per virtual date when the backend synchronizes that date; no wall-clock scheduler is installed
provisional.mini_evidence: Only evidence recorded after acceptance and linked to the instance counts for exercise mini quests; food evidence uses the existing catalog novelty validator
provisional.sensor_contract: Exercise actual values are verified increments, not repeatedly submitted cumulative pedometer snapshots
